audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown appears anywhere, and the two interactions that decide the lane are absent.
audit.why: Highlander makes Master Yi IMMUNE TO ALL SLOWS — Volcanic Rupture's slow and Call of the Forge God's slow simply do not apply while it is up, and only the knock-ups still land. Meditate is a 10s channel that any CC cancels, so a knock-up saved for the heal is worth more than one spent on poke. Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1 with untargetability, so damage spent into it is wasted — but once it is gone he cannot leave your E-Q for a very long window. Wuju Style is 14s of true damage that ignores everything you build.
audit.corrected: The slow-immunity, the Meditate cancel and the 20s / 14s / 10s / 85s numbers written into whys[1], whys[4], whys[5], early, mid and the new spikes[3].

edits.after: Highlander makes him immune to every slow for 85 seconds — Volcanic Rupture and your R stop kiting him, and only the knock-ups still land.

Zone him, chunk him on every wave and get your Living Forge value rolling; the lead you take now is the buffer for a late game that will not be kind.
